title: Edgar Sosia's modern sax and the trumpeter Kuyper
summary: Edgar Sosia played what became rock and roll licks; Kuyper was another trumpeter with the band, from the Entertainers, who played in a Louis Armstrong style.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Well, to say this, in other words, the rock and roll stuff they're playing now, the saxophone player, Edgar Socher was playing that. That's not the one Boogie Woogie or that old time Boogie Woogie? But I mean, the way they're putting that old time stuff in it. Edgar was playing, da Just like that, he was doing that years back. I used to like to hear the blues. Is Kuyper from here? No, Kuyper, not from here. Who is he? That was another trumpet player we had. He had plenty of changes. Nobody had a trumpet player?

Kuyper, who was he great? Yes sir. The run of the sun went out of the joint. He was playing at the tannifor. He was playing at the entertainers for a long time. Louis Primm and I used to go there every night and listen at him. He was in the entertainers.
What sort of style did he have?
Well he played like, he played like Ray Allen, like Lewis, something of Lewis's numbers. He played like Guy Kelly. I mean that's the type of trumpet player.
